data.long_meaning: The name Velu is derived from the Tamil word 'Vel' which means 'shining'. Velu is a name for those who are believed to shine brightly in their own unique way. It is a name that symbolizes radiance, joy, and positivity. The name Velu carries the meaning “Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Velu usually hope their child will grow to embody shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Velu is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the name Velu is associated with the Hindu god, Agni, who represents the fire of knowledge, purification, and transformation. Velu is also associated with the Sun god, Surya, who is believed to bestow light, energy, and life upon the world.

Murugan is depicted as having a spear, called Vel, which is believed to bestow power, victory, and protection.
